entities.summary: Olatunji Bello is a Nigerian lawyer, environmentalist, political scientist and journalist who served as Commissioner for Environment and Water Resources under the Babajide Sanwo-Olu administration in Lagos State from 2019 to 2023 and is the present Chief Executive Officer /Executive vice chairman of the FCCPC since June 2024.
